condition: Table.from_pandas() shares the numpy buffer of non-null numeric columns without copying it, so a later in-place cell mutation through df.iloc/df.loc also silently changes the Arrow Table, even with pandas 3.0 Copy-on-Write.
workaround: Use pyarrow-backed dtypes (e.g. dtype="int64[pyarrow]") in the DataFrame, or pass df.copy() to from_pandas before mutating the DataFrame.
